recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中幾乎看不到造血細胞，取而代之的是大量折光性、淡褐灰色的針狀結晶呈放射狀或成堆排列，周圍為纖維化間質與異物型巨細胞反應；這種針狀結晶加上異物反應、造血組織消失，是草酸鹽沉積症（oxalosis）骨髓侵犯的表現。
features: Numerous refractile, pale brown-gray needle-shaped crystals in dense sheaves and radial/rosette clusters (A, B)
Crystal deposits replacing marrow spaces and abutting pale bony trabeculae (A, B)
Fibrotic stroma with spindled fibroblasts surrounding crystal aggregates (B, C)
Foreign body-type multinucleated giant cells engulfing crystals (C)
Absence of residual hematopoietic elements in all panels
describe_en: Composite of bone marrow trephine sections (H&E, low to high power). The marrow spaces are replaced by abundant refractile, pale brown-gray, needle-like crystals arranged in sheaves and radial clusters, adjacent to thickened bony trabeculae (A, B). The crystals are embedded in fibrotic stroma with a foreign body giant cell reaction (C), and no residual hematopoiesis is identified. Polarization, if performed, would be expected to show birefringent crystals; the photomicrographs have low contrast, which limits fine detail. Findings are consistent with bone marrow oxalosis, which should prompt evaluation for primary hyperoxaluria or end-stage renal disease.

ddx.dx: Gaucher disease or other storage disorder
ddx.vs: Storage disorders show sheets of macrophages with crinkled-paper or foamy cytoplasm, not extracellular birefringent needle-shaped crystals with giant cell reaction.
Immunoglobulin crystals are intracytoplasmic within histiocytes, eosinophilic, and associated with a clonal plasma cell or B-cell neoplasm, rather than extracellular birefringent oxalate sheaves.
Metastatic tumor shows cohesive epithelial cell clusters (keratin-positive) in fibrotic stroma, without crystal deposits.
Myelofibrosis retains atypical megakaryocytes and residual hematopoiesis in reticulin/collagen fibrosis and lacks crystals and foreign body giant cells.
